metadata.description:
The Tribal Kitchen team travelled to the Nilagiri block of Odisha recently. Here we met people of the Ho tribe, and went hunting into the Jungle for a very very small animal called Hau in their local Ho language. Please watch the entire episode to know more about our experience and the animal we hunted.

Anchor - Shyam Sunder
